scenes.fallbackText: RAIN ERASES THE LESS IMPORTANT MARKS.

lines.text: THE ARCHIVE CLOSES WHEN RAIN REACHES THE LOWER STAIR.
DATES ARE COPIED. PAPER IS HARDER TO FORGE.
THAT MILL MARK WAS NOT SOLD UNTIL AFTER THE FLOOD.
THE CHAPEL REGISTER SHOULD HAVE BURNED THAT WINTER.
THE DATE IS IMPOSSIBLE. THE SERVICE KEY IS YOURS.

actions.text: THE INK CLAIMS A DATE BEFORE THIS PAPER EXISTED.
THE DATE AND THE PAPER CANNOT BOTH BE TRUE.
THE HARBOUR RECORD NAMES THE PAPER MILL AND YEAR.

states.fallbackText: THE DRAWER IS JAMMED WITH OLD FORMS.
THE CLERK WAITS FOR A PRECISE QUESTION.
THE CHAPEL DOOR OPENS TOWARD THE RIVER.

actions.text: THE SERVICE DOOR NEEDS THE CLERK KEY.
THE REGISTRY PLACES THE DEBTOR HERE ON THAT DATE.
THE CHAPEL COPY IS ENOUGH TO CHALLENGE THE ACCOUNT.

states.fallbackText: THE REGISTRY IS LEGIBLE UNDER THE DUST.
THE DOOR RETURNS TO THE ARCHIVE.
THE DOOR RETURNS TO THE ARCHIVE.

actions.text: THE FALSE DEBT HID A ROUTE THROUGH THE FLOODED WARDS.
THE CASE IS PROVED. THE NEXT ROUTE IS NOW VISIBLE.

states.fallbackText: THE LEDGER WAITS UNDER THE RAIN.
